result_summary: TDE hang investigation complete. Root causes identified: (1) Unbounded substep count in PhysicsEngine.js:136 with no cap, (2) SPH smoothing length computed from origin instead of center-of-mass causing O(N^2) degradation after disruption, (3) Trail updates inside substep loop causing massive element-move operations, (4) O(N^2) ConservationLedger called every frame.
